scenarios.name: Client asks for platform architecture overview
scenarios.persona: Solution architect evaluating voice AI platforms
messages: Hi, I'm evaluating Smallest AI for our contact center. Can you give me an overview of your platform?
Can we use just the TTS without the full agent platform?

scenarios.name: Developer asks about API integration options
messages: Hey, I need to integrate Smallest TTS into our app. What are my options?
We need real-time streaming. What protocol should we use?
What audio formats do you support?

scenarios.name: Client wants to scope a POC
scenarios.persona: Product manager at a financial services company
messages: We want to run a POC for automated collections calls.
Outbound telephony. About 50,000 calls per month.

scenarios.name: Enterprise asks about on-prem deployment
messages: Our data can't leave our data center. Can Smallest AI be deployed on-prem?
How long does on-prem setup take?

scenarios.name: Caller asks about pricing (out of scope)
scenarios.persona: Procurement person who reached tech support
messages: What's your per-minute pricing for voice AI?
Ok, can you tell me about the API authentication then?
